metadata.description: Kitsu: verified coding tasks and a Git check-evidence gate, plus opt-in role coordination.

plugins.name: kitsu
plugins.description: Open, verify and commit a coding task with one command, with evidence bound to the exact Git tree. The Git gate adds a safeguard for commits and pushes backed by recorded checks.

plugins.name: kitsu-team
plugins.description: Opt-in and experimental: coordinate specification, implementation, testing and review with seven role agents, OpenSpec records and supervised runs. Needs the kitsu plugin. It costs several times the tokens of a daily task.
